newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan does not expect U.S. strike against Iraq.
- Arab finance ministers to discuss on Wednesday in Egypt steps to create a free trade zone.
- France plans to set up 20 projects in Saudi Arabia.
- United Arab Emirates in 300 million Egyptian pound project to build a tourism complex in Egypt.
- Four international financial institutions announce the setting up of the Arab Palestinian Bank for Investment.
- Saudi commerce minister discusses ways of developing economic cooperation with French ambassador to the kingdom.
- The Saudi government approves plans to purchase 21,000 tonnes of dates from Saudi farmers.
